location.description: The location of the resource is critical for compliance and security purposes. This attribute is already covered by an implemented policy in another relevant resource. Therefore, a separate policy was not created for this resource.
location.rationale: The location of the resource is critical for compliance and security purposes.

qa_scorecard.description: Resource ID segment making up resource `name`. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.
qa_scorecard.rationale: Provides the ID of the parent QaScorecard. No direct security impact.

revision.description: Resource ID segment making up resource `name`. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.
revision.rationale: Provides the ID of the parent QaScorecardRevision. No direct security impact.

abbreviation.description: Short, descriptive string, used in the UI where it's not practical to display the full question body. E.g., "Greeting".
abbreviation.rationale: Provides a short, descriptive string for the question. No direct security impact.

answer_choices.description: A list of valid answers to the question, which the LLM must choose from. Structure is [documented below](#nested_answer_choices).
answer_choices.rationale: Provides the list of valid answers for the question. No direct security impact.

bool_value.rationale: Provides a boolean value for the answer choice. No direct security impact.

key.description: A short string used as an identifier.
key.rationale: Provides a short string used as an identifier for the answer choice. No direct security impact.

na_value.description: A value of "Not Applicable (N/A)". If provided, this field may only be set to `true`. If a question receives this answer, it will be excluded from any score calculations.
na_value.rationale: Indicates if the answer is not applicable. No direct security impact.

num_value.rationale: Provides a numerical value for the answer choice. No direct security impact.

score.description: Numerical score of the answer, used for generating the overall score of a QaScorecardResult. If the answer uses na_value, this field is unused.
score.rationale: Provides a numerical score for the answer. No direct security impact.

str_value.rationale: Provides a string value for the answer choice. No direct security impact.

answer_instructions.description: Instructions describing how to determine the answer.
answer_instructions.rationale: Provides instructions for determining the answer. No direct security impact.

metrics.description: A wrapper representing metrics calculated against a test-set on a LLM that was fine tuned for this question. Structure is [documented below](#nested_metrics).
metrics.rationale: Represents metrics calculated against a test-set on a LLM. No direct security impact.

accuracy.description: Accuracy of the model. Measures the percentage of correct answers the model gave on the test set.
accuracy.rationale: Provides the accuracy metric for the model. No direct security impact.

order.description: Defines the order of the question within its parent scorecard revision.
order.rationale: Defines the order of the question within its parent scorecard revision. No direct security impact.

predefined_question_config.description: Configuration for a predefined question. This field will only be set if the Question Type is predefined. Structure is [documented below](#nested_predefined_question_config).
predefined_question_config.rationale: Provides configuration for a predefined question. No direct security impact.

type.description: The type of the predefined question. Possible values: CONVERSATION_OUTCOME CONVERSATION_OUTCOME_ESCALATION_INITIATOR_ROLE
type.rationale: Defines the type of the predefined question. No direct security impact.

qa_question_data_options.description: Options for configuring the data used to generate the QA question. Structure is [documented below](#nested_qa_question_data_options).
qa_question_data_options.rationale: Provides options for configuring the data used to generate the QA question. No direct security impact.

conversation_data_options.description: Options for configuring what metadata is included in the conversation data used in QAI and Discovery Engine. Structure is [documented below](#nested_qa_question_data_options_conversation_data_options).
conversation_data_options.rationale: Provides options for configuring the conversation data used in QAI and Discovery Engine. No direct security impact.

include_dialogflow_interaction_data.description: Whether to include the per turn Dialogflow interaction data in conversation transcript.
include_dialogflow_interaction_data.rationale: Determines whether to include Dialogflow interaction data in the conversation transcript. No direct security impact.

question_body.description: Question text. E.g., "Did the agent greet the customer?"
question_body.rationale: Represents the text of the question. No direct security impact.

question_type.description: The type of question. Possible values: CUSTOMIZABLE PREDEFINED
question_type.rationale: Defines the type of the question. No direct security impact.

tags.description: Questions are tagged for categorization and scoring. Tags can either be: - Default Tags: These are predefined categories. They are identified by their string value (e.g., "BUSINESS", "COMPLIANCE", and "CUSTOMER"). - Custom Tags: These are user-defined categories. They are identified by their full resource name (e.g., projects/{project}/locations/{location}/qaQuestionTags/{qa_question_tag}). Both default and custom tags are used to group questions and to influence the scoring of each question.
tags.rationale: Provides tags for categorization and scoring of questions. No direct security impact.

tuning_metadata.description: Metadata about the tuning operation for the question. Will only be set if a scorecard containing this question has been tuned. Structure is [documented below](#nested_tuning_metadata).
tuning_metadata.rationale: Provides metadata about the tuning operation for the question. No direct security impact.

dataset_validation_warnings.description: A list of any applicable data validation warnings about the question's feedback labels.
dataset_validation_warnings.rationale: Provides warnings about data validation issues with the question's feedback labels. No direct security impact.

total_valid_label_count.description: Total number of valid labels provided for the question at the time of tuining.
total_valid_label_count.rationale: Represents the total number of valid labels provided for the question at the time of tuning. No direct security impact.

tuning_error.description: Error status of the tuning operation for the question. Will only be set if the tuning operation failed.
tuning_error.rationale: Represents the error status of the tuning operation for the question. No direct security impact.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Represents the ID of the project to which the resource belongs. No direct security impact.
